evals.prompt: Decision-path probe only; do not implement or launch tools. A developer has rejected the entire layout of an existing scheduling app and invoked /trash. Earlier session requirements retain Japanese labels, member identity colors, search, month/week switch, keyboard navigation, saved filters, CSV export and mobile use. Current design scatters actions among identical cards. They want a full redo and independent council, not a small patch. Describe the execution sequence and completion gates you would follow in at most 300 words. Do not claim anything has already been executed.
evals.expected_output: Substantive composition replacement preserving all named capabilities, current-session recovery, applicable skill synthesis and real rendering plus separate independent review.
expectations: Specifies substantive layout/composition replacement rather than cosmetic changes.
Explicitly retains all eight named capabilities or an unambiguous complete inventory.
Requires actual rendered/runtime checks before completion.
Requires a separate independent reviewer rather than builder self-review.

expectations: Preserves undo/redo, import/export, shortcuts, 320px support and brand colors.
